title: Former mayoral candidate JD Gonzalez endorses Mayor Victor Treviño in Laredo runoff
excerpt: Former Laredo mayoral candidate JD Gonzalez has thrown his support behind incumbent Mayor Dr. Victor Treviño in the December 12 mayoral runoff against District 8 Council Member Alyssa Cigarroa.
content:
Former Laredo mayoral candidate JD Gonzalez has endorsed incumbent Mayor Dr. Victor Treviño in the December 12 mayoral runoff, Hammrod News Laredo TX reported Tuesday, November 10, 2026.

Gonzalez, a local businessman, customs broker and U.S. Navy veteran, finished third in the November 3 mayoral election with 10,270 votes, or 18.71 percent of the vote.

Treviño will face District 8 Council Member Alyssa Cigarroa in the runoff. Cigarroa led the November 3 vote with 19,510 votes (35.54 percent), while Treviño finished second with 17,725 votes (32.29 percent) — a gap of 1,785 votes. No candidate won a majority in the five-candidate race, forcing the runoff.

During his campaign, Gonzalez focused on improving Laredo's aging water infrastructure, strengthening international trade, supporting local businesses and bringing greater accountability to City Hall. He also pointed to more than 30 years of business experience and his military service.

With more than 10,000 Laredo voters having backed Gonzalez in the general election, his endorsement adds another development to the closely watched runoff.

LAREDO MAYORAL RUNOFF ELECTION 2026

Early Voting: November 30 – December 8, 2026

Election Day: Saturday, December 12, 2026

Source: Hammrod News Laredo TX, November 10, 2026. Vote totals per Webb County election results as reported by the Laredo Morning Times.
